Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1227
Claimant:
Michael Wells
Adjuster:
Christopher Wong
10/26/2023
Reported a left-turn collision at an intersection, in which an oncoming car struck the policyholder's vehicle as it turned.
The claimant is represented by counsel, so all contact will go through that office.
11/03/2023
Spoke with the household driver, who confirms the vehicle was turning left when the other car came through the
junction. Police attended the scene and recorded the claimant as being in the vehicle at the time.
12/26/2023
The other driver's account matches the policyholder's description of how the impact happened. Witnesses and scene
photographs are consistent with that same sequence.
01/15/2024
Claimant reports neck and back strain. The injury pattern described fits well with the kind and force expected from a
side-on impact of this type.
03/04/2024
The claimant has added some smaller details in later calls, but the core account has stayed the same. No earlier
injury to the neck or back is known to us.
05/01/2024
Treatment has followed a usual course, with visits tapering off as the claimant reported improvement. Counsel has
asked for copies of the treatment records.
05/18/2024
Inspection shows damage to the left side of the vehicle. No earlier damage to the vehicle is known, but it is not yet
clear whether all of the damage came from this impact.
05/23/2024
A repair estimate that predates the policy start shows this same damage already existed. Referred to the claims
supervisor for review before any further decision is made.
06/02/2024
The driver lives with the policyholder and is covered as a household member under the policy. Coverage position
remains under review pending resolution of the estimate question.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
